strings.jp: 「わしは いつまでも{n} ここで 待っておるぞ！{n} ウヒャヒャ…」{wait}

strings.en: "My art is fit for Urashima to learn!"{wait}"Oh! Why, what's this! That Urashima is badly injured!"{wait}"Momotaro! You're a child of courage who cherishes his friends, aren't you?"{wait}"Hurry and take him to a doctor and get him healed!"{wait}

strings.jp: 「わしは いつまでも{n} ここで 待っておるぞ！」{n}{wait}{n}「さあ ゆけ！ 桃太郎！」
strings.en: "I'll be waiting here forever!"{wait}"Now go, Momotaro!"

strings.jp: 「ばいりきの術は{n} 味方の 攻撃力が{n} 戦闘中に ふえるのぢゃ！」{wait}{n}「この 術を 覚えるのは{n} 浦島が ふさわしい！」{n}{wait}

strings.en: "Hurry and learn my art, and teach those oni a lesson!"{wait}"But first, you must undergo my rather strict training!"{wait}

strings.jp: 「わしの術は ちと{n} 覚えるのが めんどーでな！{n} だれも 覚えようとせん！」{wait}{n}「なんかいか わしを たずねれば{n} いいだけなんぢゃが…」{n}{wait}
strings.en: "My art is a bit of a bother to learn! Nobody ever wants to learn it!"{wait}"All you have to do is come and see me a few times, though..."{wait}

strings.jp: 「これから お前たちを{n} どこか遠くに 飛ばすから{n} ここまで 戻ってくるのぢゃ！」{wait}
strings.en: "Now I'm going to send you flying somewhere far away, and you must make your way back here!"{wait}

strings.jp: 「よしよし！{n} ちゃんと 戻ってきたか！」{n}{wait}{n}「それでは もう一度ぢゃ！{n} そーれ！ 行ってこい！」{n}{wait}
strings.en: "Good, good! You made it back!"{wait}"Then once more! Heave-ho! Off you go!"{wait}

strings.jp: 「ウヒャヒャ… よくぞ{n} この 修行に たえたのォ！」{n}{wait}{n}「浦島よ！{n} ばいりきの術を{n} さずけようぞ！ ウヒャヒャ…」{wait}
strings.en: "Uhyahya... You endured my training very well!"{wait}"Urashima! I shall grant you the Power art! Uhyahya..."{wait}
